observers.label: Caption-blind observer 1 (Claude)

answers.1: A human head and neck seen from behind and slightly to the right, showing the back of the head, the right ear region, and the right side of the neck. Short dark hair is visible on top.
answers.2: A white bandage wrapped in several overlapping turns around the head, passing above the ear. Over the area behind and below the right ear sits a square gauze pad with two strips of tape crossing it in an X. Part of the ear, the cheek, and eyelashes show at the right edge. No skin wound, redness, or fluid is drawn.
answers.3: No text, arrows, labels, or symbols.
answers.4: A patient might read it as a head-injury or skull-surgery wrap rather than an ear-area dressing, or worry the X-taped pad marks a serious wound or something covered up.
